overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by omitting the required list of documents used from its minutes, ordered the September 6 and 20 minutes revised within 30 days, and left the untimely August 23 minutes unreviewed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to list documents used at several meetings in the minutes, as G.L. c. 30A, § 22(a) requires.
allegations.key_passage: In its response, the Board concedes that it failed to include the required list of documents used during each meeting, and it pledges to include the list in minutes moving forward.

allegations.summary: Complaint also challenged the August 23 minutes, which were approved more than 30 days before the complaint was filed.
allegations.key_passage: Because the present complaint was filed more than 30 days after the August 23 minutes were approved, we do not include those minutes as part of our review in this letter.

remedy: Within thirty (30) days of receipt of the letter, revise the minutes of the September 6 and 20 meetings to include the list of documents used during those meetings.
Upon completing the amendments, notify the Attorney General's office of compliance in writing, pursuant to 940 CMR 29.07(4).
remedy_passage: we order the Board, within thirty (30) days of receipt of this letter, to revise the minutes of its September 6 and 20 meetings to include the list of documents used during those meetings.
